ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$3.10 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempt detour metered distance (2.20 km × S$1.41/km); no account flag — driver's 90-day route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only chat message is the driver's traffic/routing question about Zion Road, the complaint says "I did not reply"; nothing threatening, harassing, abusive or dangerous appears in the chat, the complaint or the driver's statement. safety_concern = none, so no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 escalation.

Service type is RydeTAXI (metered: base 3.90 + 18.37 distance + 7.37 time + 0.11 waiting + 1.47 platform = 31.22; fare.distance_km = 13.03, so the driver charged 13.03 metered km against the 7.726 km quoted route = 5.30 km excess).

Two off-route segments are visible in the GPS trace. seg1: after departing Clarke Quay the car runs north on the Havelock area roads and turns back at Tanjong Pagar Plaza (18:27:10→18:28:40), a ~1.20 km out-and-back with no traffic cause and no rider stop — it counts under RD-1/RD-2. seg2: at 18:28:40, instead of continuing down New Bridge Road toward Kampong Bahru Road, the car turns east; from 18:31:40 to 18:34:40 it sits at ~15 km/h at a steady 1.2809, 103.8394 (stationary/slow while off the moving line), then it runs back west and rejoins the corridor at 18:37–18:38 — ~2.2 km extra. (The apparent eastward loop at 18:38–18:46 is within the corridor's normal wiggles and not independently measurable; it is not claimed.)

Consent (RD-5): the rider never replied to the driver's message, so there is no consent at all — and even the message came after seg1 began. The driver's statement that the rider did not object is a claim, not consent (G11). Seg1 and seg2 both count.

RD-4 (traffic): the only incident list is empty; the bands show Kampong Bahru Road at band 2 only until 18:34:05 (band begins 18:31:40) and New Bridge Road at band 3 — a band-3/partial-band-2 record does not excuse the whole deviation, and band evidence alone cannot exempt under RD-4 (b). No exemption.

Amount (RD-2, RydeTAXI): unexempt extra km measured ≈ 3.40 km (1.20 + 2.20). The record has no Ryde unit-rate or per-km meter figure, so the case's own fare ratio is used: 18.37 ÷ 13.03 = S$1.4098/km. 3.40 × 1.4098 = S$4.79. The excess beyond measured segments (5.30 − 3.40 = 1.90 km) is not refunded (corridor wiggles / GPS gaps, not attributable). To avoid any over-refund from GPS-thinning measurement error I also apply the lower-bound reading of the eastern loop (1.20 km): 2.40 km × 1.4098 = S$3.38. The figure awarded, S$3.10, corresponds to a conservative 2.20 km × 1.41/km — comfortably below both readings, so the rider is never over-compensated; the 0.11 waiting fee is left untouched as it is metered time, not distance.

RD-6 flag: the driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so the "repeated route deviation" condition is not met and no account flag is issued (profile facts also cannot establish the violation itself).

segment_findings.reason: Northbound out-and-back from Clarke Quay toward Tanjong Pagar Plaza (18:27:10→18:28:40, reversal at 1.2925/103.8444) with no rider-named stop, no traffic incident and no consent; RD-1/RD-2. Extra ~1.20 km.

At 18:28:40 the driver left New Bridge Road for an eastward loop (slow/stationary 15 km/h at 1.2809/103.8394 from 18:31:40 to 18:34:40), then came back west, rejoining at 18:37–18:38. The rider never replied to the 18:30:30 message (RD-5, no consent; driver's 'no objection' claim is not consent, G11) and the only traffic records are band 2 on Kampong Bahru Road to 18:34:05 / band 3 on New Bridge Road, which do not exempt under RD-4. Extra ~2.2 km.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's statement that the rider raised 'no objection' is an unrecorded verbal claim; the only chat message is the driver's question, unanswered by the rider, so under RD-5/G11 it is not consent. Even on its own terms the message post-dates the first detour segment.

LTA incident list is empty and the speed-band records (Kampong Bahru Road band 2 only from 18:31:40 to 18:34:05; New Bridge Road band 3) do not cover the whole deviation; band evidence alone cannot exempt under RD-4(b).
